|game_text=If you have no Epic Events on table (and did not play an Epic Even at the start of the game), deploy on table. Once per game, may take a [Setup] card into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. May place this Effect in Used Pile to take an Immediate Effect into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. |errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Luke, Trust Me]]. Other errata versions: [[Luke, Trust Me (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, the current text). No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB7-03-Luke_Trust_Me-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 8 November 2026; icons drawn as on the slip). The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-03-Luke_Trust_Me.png]]) shows the original text (see [[Luke, Trust Me]]); the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-L-luketrustme-pre.gif]]) shows the PC-E2 text (see [[Luke, Trust Me (Errata 2)]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Luke, Trust Me]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet (official text as of 18 June 2010): “Unless your Epic Event on table, deploy on table. Once per game, may ▲ a [Setup] card. May place this Effect in Used Pile to ▲ an Immediate Effect. May place this Effect in Lost Pile to cancel a Force drain. (Immune to Alter.)”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 18 June 2010"; copy re-made 28 July 2010). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174512/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) changed “Unless your Epic Event on table,” to “If you have no Epic Events on table (and did not play an Epic Even at the start of the game),” (“Even” as printed there): “If you have no Epic Events on table (and did not play an Epic Even at the start of the game), deploy on table. Once per game, may take a [Setup] card into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. May place this Effect in Used Pile to take an Immediate Effect into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. May place this Effect in Lost Pile to cancel a Force drain. (Immune to Alter.)”<ref name="cl-1271_39-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref> The card list writes the slip's icons out (▼ as “deploy … from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”, ▲ as “take … into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”); that alone is not a version.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Luke, Trust Me (Errata 2)]]): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints “Epic Event” for the card list's “Epic Even”: “If you have no Epic Events on table (and did not play an Epic Event at the start of the game), deploy on table. Once per game, may ▲ a [Setup] card. May place this Effect in Used Pile to ▲ an Immediate Effect. May place this Effect in Lost Pile to cancel a Force drain. (Immune to Alter.)”<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee card image (marked E) prints the same text.
